Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing motorcycles to stop and proceed through traffic control signals under certain conditions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing motorcycles to stop and proceed throughtraffic control signals under certain conditions; and adding a newsection to chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Law enforcement personnel may not find an operator of amotorcycle who enters or crosses an intersection controlled by atraffic control signal against a steady red indicator, includingtraffic control signals equipped with automated traffic safety cameras,to be in violation of this chapter, chapter 46.63 RCW, or local lawsif, as an affirmative defense to such a violation, the operatorestablishes all of the following conditions: (a) The motorcycle has been brought to a complete stop; (b) The traffic control signal continues to display a steady redindicator for more than ninety seconds; (c) The traffic control signal is apparently malfunctioning or, ifprogrammed or engineered to change to a steady green indicator only p. 1 SHB 1238after detecting the approach of a motor vehicle, the signal hasapparently failed to detect the arrival of the motorcycle; and (d) Another motor vehicle or person is not approaching on thestreet or highway to be crossed or entered or is at a far enoughdistance from the intersection that it does not constitute an immediatehazard. (2) The affirmative defense provided in subsection (1) of thissection applies only to a violation of entering or crossing anintersection controlled by a traffic control signal against a steadyred indicator and is not a defense to any other civil or criminalaction.
